# chameleon_rs

> Chameleon templates, modernized: a Rust engine that runs Chameleon templates unchanged, several times faster, with async rendering and built-in framework integrations.

## Docs

### API Reference

#### Templates
> Compile and render templates from strings, files and folders.

- [PageTemplate](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/PageTemplate.html): Constructor for the page template language, rendered by the Rust VM
- [PageTemplateFile](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/PageTemplateFile.html): File-based page template loaded from ``filename`` when first used
- [PageTextTemplate](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/PageTextTemplate.html): Text-based template class: only ``${...}`` interpolation, no markup, nothing escaped
- [PageTextTemplateFile](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/PageTextTemplateFile.html): File-based text template whose ``render()`` returns ``bytes`` (UTF-8 by default)
- [PageTemplateLoader](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/PageTemplateLoader.html): Loads and caches page templates from one or more directories by filename (``loader['page.pt']``)

#### PageTemplate Methods
> Methods for the PageTemplate class

- [PageTemplate.__getitem__](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/PageTemplate.__getitem__.html)
- [PageTemplate.engine](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/PageTemplate.engine.html)
- [PageTemplate.expression_parser](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/PageTemplate.expression_parser.html)
- [PageTemplate.builtins](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/PageTemplate.builtins.html)
- [PageTemplate.parse](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/PageTemplate.parse.html)
- [PageTemplate.include](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/PageTemplate.include.html)
- [PageTemplate.render](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/PageTemplate.render.html)
- [PageTemplate.render_async](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/PageTemplate.render_async.html)
- [PageTemplate.digest](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/PageTemplate.digest.html)

#### Configuration
> Process-wide settings for templates loaded by name, partials and Markdown.

- [configure](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/configure.html): Configures chameleon-rs for the whole process (partials, framework integrations, and Markdown)
- [core_version](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/core_version.html): Version of the Rust core, for bug reports and for checking which build is loaded

#### Async
> Opt-in concurrency for render_async. See also PageTemplate.render_async.

- [concurrent](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/concurrent.html): Marks an async helper so that an asynchronous render awaits its calls concurrently

#### Partials
> Render one template inside another. Also chameleon_partials' API.

- [render_partial](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/render_partial.html): Renders a partial template by path and returns an ``HTML`` object
- [partials.register_extensions](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/partials.register_extensions.html)
- [partials.extend_model](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/partials.extend_model.html)
- [partials.clear](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/partials.clear.html)
- [partials.PartialRenderer](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/partials.PartialRenderer.html)
- [partials.HTML](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/partials.HTML.html)
- [partials.PartialsException](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/partials.PartialsException.html)

#### Errors and web helpers
> Exceptions, and the pieces shared by the framework integrations.

- [TemplateError](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/TemplateError.html): Base class for compile-time template errors (``ParseError``, ``CompilationError``, ``ExpressionError``)
- [web.TemplateError](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/web.TemplateError.html)
- [web.ErrorPage](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/web.ErrorPage.html)
- [web.NotFound](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/web.NotFound.html)
- [web.TemplateNotFound](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/web.TemplateNotFound.html)
- [web.DecoratorOrderError](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/web.DecoratorOrderError.html)
- [web.model_of](https://mkennedy.codes/docs/chameleon-rs/reference/web.model_of.html)
